Here’s a quick way to make the copy and keep the new name:

```bash
# 1️⃣ Go to the Documentation folder
cd Documentation

# 2️⃣ Copy the file into the Archives sub‑folder and rename it in one step
cp FinalReport.txt Archives/ArchivedFinalReport2024.txt
```

If your `cp` command doesn’t allow the “destination / new‑name” syntax, you can do it in two steps:

```bash
# Copy the file into the Archives folder (keeps the original name)
cp FinalReport.txt Archives/

# Rename the copy inside Archives
mv Archives/FinalReport.txt Archives/ArchivedFinalReport2024.txt
```

Either approach will leave you with a duplicate of `FinalReport.txt` inside `Documentation/Archives` named `ArchivedFinalReport2024.txt`.
